parsed.reply: Hi! Access to Delta Sky Club with your Amex Platinum is only available when flying Delta or a Delta-marketed flight that day. If you're flying another airline, access isn't included. Let me know if you have other questions!
parsed.grounding_used: I followed the pattern clarifying Sky Club access rules related to same-day Delta or Delta-marketed flights, as in the historical reply about Sky Club Members only using the Club with same-day ticketed air travel.
